content:
Do we care about this sort of hygiene? #42235

This has no perf implications as far as I know. I suppose the biggest impact is that it modifies the autocomplete feature in the editor, and I guess opinions might differ on if having 'extra' stuff suggested as one types is a pro or a con.

I ran into issues where unused opened namespaces can cause issues with shake, cf. #mathlib4 > shake @ 💬 and lean#12832 so I think removing these is a good idea. As mentioned on the issue, I think a linter for these would be greatly appreciated.
What about detecting when open can be weakened to open scoped?
